author: Basim Hammad
text: We've used NBRS for a year+ on a bimonthly basis to service the restaurant's Grease Trap & hydro jet the plumbing lines. They've been great! Their client onboarding and quoting was great. Their automated scheduling system makes life a little easier running a business. I got a chance to run into one of their service Tech today, Evan, and he was super courteous and helpful. A business that knows how to do B2B. Thank you!

author: Diana Banas
text: North Bay Restaurant Services is outstanding! Their office team is incredibly knowledgable and prompt with replies. Scheduling grease trap services and payment was a breeze. The technicians are and thorough and courteous. No exaggeration, I've never been more excited about getting our kitchen grease trap pumped because the North Bay Restaurant Services team is so great! If your restaurant is even thinking about switching grease trap service providers or is researching options, book with North Bay, you won't be disappointed!

author: Matt Holt
text: North Bay are total pros!  They have regularly serviced our equipment and done a great job.  Recently, we had some lengthy supply chain delays replacing a piece of equipment, and their team was ready to help install immediately and expedite repairs!  Their communication throughout the process was even more impressive.  Shannon and her team were in touch almost daily to offer help or ask for status updates.  They went above and beyond and earned an even more loyal customer.

author: Ray Simon
text:
Five-Star Review for North Bay Restaurant Services
We recently had the pleasure of working with North Bay Restaurant Services, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the results. Eddie, Able, and Neo did an outstanding job over the course of two nights — deep cleaning all of our kitchen equipment the first night and tackling the kitchen and bar floors the second night.
The team completely disassembled our cooking equipment, thoroughly scrubbing and pressure-washing every part. They removed layers of built-up grease and grime, then polished all the stainless-steel surfaces until everything looked brand new. They even took the extra time to move what they could and clean underneath and behind the equipment — a level of thoroughness that really stood out.
They didn’t stop there — the crew also cleaned the walls and surrounding areas, leaving the entire kitchen and bar spotless. Eddie, Able, and Neo were friendly, professional, and incredibly hard-working. Their efficiency and attention to detail made a huge difference.
I highly recommend North Bay Restaurant Services to anyone looking for top-quality kitchen cleaning and exceptional service.

author: Chris Apodaca
text: Eddie did a nice job, he left everything clean in a reasonable time. I recommend him. 10 out of 10.
